name: Mixed operation histories
note: Draft unscored qualification pilot. Three fixed schedules of 30 sequential operations, two customers, two products and two warehouses. Reconcile native state after every operation. The first displayed pending or cancelled order is selected through its declared input; no order sorting is required. Stock holds are optional. Reconnect must not repeat a write. This is bounded history correctness, not a concurrency solver, throughput test, session-expiry rule or payment-provider audit.

criteria.desc: each completed operation preserves order ownership, booked totals, carts and stock, with cancellation restored once
